disciplinary_grounds.description: False statements, representations, fraud, or deceit in obtaining admission to practice or in the practice of any branch of the healing arts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: False statements or representations or fraud or deceit in obtaining admission to the practice, or fraud or deceit in the practice of any branch of the healing arts;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Substance abuse rendering the licensee unfit for professional obligations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Substance abuse rendering him unfit for the performance of his professional obligations and duties;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentional or negligent conduct in practice that causes or is likely to cause injury to a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentional or negligent conduct in the practice of any branch of the healing arts that causes or is likely to cause injury to a patient or patients;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental or physical incapacity or incompetence to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental or physical incapacity or incompetence to practice his profession with safety to his patients and the public;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Restriction of a license to practice in another state, DC, US possession, territory, or foreign jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Restriction of a license to practice a branch of the healing arts in another state, the District of Columbia, a United States possession or territory, or a foreign jurisdiction, or for an entity of the federal government;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Undertaking to procure or perform a criminal abortion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Undertaking in any manner or by any means whatsoever to procure or perform or aid or abet in procuring or performing a criminal abortion;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing under a false or assumed name, or impersonating another practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of any of the healing arts under a false or assumed name, or impersonating another practitioner of a like, similar, or different name;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or dispensing controlled substances with intent they be used non-medicinally or to evade law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing or dispensing any controlled substance with intent or knowledge that it will be used otherwise than medicinally, or for accepted therapeutic purposes, or with intent to evade any law with respect to the sale, use, or disposition of such drug;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating provisions on division of fees or practicing in violation of chapter provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating provisions of this chapter on division of fees or practicing any branch of the healing arts in violation of the provisions of this chapter;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly and willfully committing a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude under state or federal law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly and willfully committing an act that is a felony under the laws of the Commonwealth or the United States, or any act that is a misdemeanor under such laws and involves moral turpitude;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding, abetting, or lending name to a person known to be practicing illegally
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting, having professional connection with, or lending his name to any person known to him to be practicing illegally any of the healing arts;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conducting practice contrary to the standards of ethics of the healing arts branch
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conducting his practice in a manner contrary to the standards of ethics of his branch of the healing arts;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conducting practice in a manner dangerous to patients or public health and welfare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conducting his practice in such a manner as to be a danger to the health and welfare of his patients or to the public;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable skill or safety due to illness or substance abuse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice with reasonable skill or safety because of illness or substance abuse;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing an advertisement that contains a claim of superiority or violates Board advertising regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publishing in any manner an advertisement relating to his professional practice that contains a claim of superiority or violates Board regulations governing advertising;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing any act likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any act likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any statute or regulation relating to the manufacture, distribution, dispensing, or administration of drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of statute or regulation, state or federal, relating to the manufacture, distribution, dispensing, or administration of drugs;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or cooperating with others in violating provisions of applicable chapters or Board regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or cooperating with others in violating any of the provisions of Chapters 1 (§ 54.1-100 et seq.), 24 (§ 54.1-2400 et seq.) and this chapter or regulations of the Board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual contact with a patient concurrent with and by virtue of the practitioner-patient relationship
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in sexual contact with a patient concurrent with and by virtue of the practitioner and patient relationship or otherwise engaging at any time during the course of the practitioner and patient relationship in conduct of a sexual nature that a reasonable patient would consider lewd and offensive;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction in any state, territory, or country of any felony or crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction in any state, territory, or country of any felony or of any crime involving moral turpitude;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudication of legal incompetence or incapacity in any state if in effect and not declared restored
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Adjudication of legal incompetence or incapacity in any state if such adjudication is in effect and the person has not been declared restored to competence or capacity;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing medical examiner services without being listed on the National Registry of Certified Medical Examiners
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing the services of a medical examiner as defined in 49 C.F.R. § 390.5 if, at the time such services are performed, the person performing such services is not listed on the National Registry of Certified Medical Examiners

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing or refusing to complete and file electronically any medical certification in accordance with statutory requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing or refusing to complete and file electronically using the Electronic Death Registration System any medical certification in accordance with the requirements of subsection C of § 32.1-263.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a pattern of violations of § 38.2-3445.01
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in a pattern of violations of § 38.2-3445.01.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of podiatry" means the prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and cure or alleviation of physical conditions, diseases, pain, or infirmities of the human foot and ankle, including the medical, mechanical and surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot and ankle, but does not include amputation of the foot proximal to the transmetatarsal level through the metatarsal shafts. Amputations proximal to the metatarsal-phalangeal joints may only be performed in a hospital or ambulatory surgery facility accredited by an organization listed in § 54.1-2939. The practice includes the diagnosis and treatment of lower extremity ulcers; however, the treatment of severe lower extremity ulcers proximal to the foot and ankle may only be performed by appropriately trained, credentialed podiatrists in an approved hospital or ambulatory surgery center at which the podiatrist has privileges, as described in § 54.1-2939. The Board of Medicine shall determine whether a specific type of treatment of the foot and ankle is within the scope of practice of podiatry.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of podiatry" means the prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and cure or alleviation of physical conditions, diseases, pain, or infirmities of the human foot and ankle, including the medical, mechanical and surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot and ankle, but does not include amputation of the foot proximal to the transmetatarsal level through the metatarsal shafts.

advanced_practice_nurse_collaboration_au.quote: A certified registered nurse anesthetist shall practice under the supervision of a licensed doctor of medicine, osteopathy, podiatry, or dentistry

assistant_surgeon_role_authorized.quote: "Practice of surgical assisting" means the performance of significant surgical tasks, including manipulation of organs, suturing of tissue, placement of hemostatic agents, injection of local anesthetic, harvesting of veins, implementation of devices, and other duties as directed by a licensed doctor of medicine, osteopathy, or podiatry under the direct supervision of a licensed doctor of medicine, osteopathy, or podiatry.
